page.title: Add-ons
page.subtitle: Extend ishflow with integrations and features

items.oneC: Imports 1C:Бухгалтерия 8.3 files as products, customers and invoices.
items.bankImport: Upload a bank statement as OFX/MT940/CSV and match it as payments/receipts.
items.stripe: Send the invoice as a link, collect by card/Apple Pay. Automatic posting.
items.aiOcr: Capture a PDF/photo invoice, transcribe it, auto-fill the lines. Beta.
items.egov: E-invoice / e-archive UBL submission, fiscal seal, status lookup.
items.qr: Place a QR code on the invoice, request payment via mobile banking.
items.generic: Send an HTTP webhook for every event. Bridge to Slack, Make, Zapier.
items.custom: Write a custom posting rule in JavaScript. Start from community templates.

generic.title: Generic Webhook
generic.subtitle: Any-tool integration via HTTP POST
generic.name: Generic Webhook
generic.desc: POSTs a JSON payload to the URL you specify on every domain event. Slack, Make, Zapier, n8n, your own backend — all connect through this add-on. Supports HMAC signing + retries.
features: Subscribe to any of 50+ event types
A separate channel per endpoint — production + staging + test
HMAC SHA-256 verification with a whsec_ signature
Exponential backoff retries (3 / 5 / 10 attempts)
Delivery history UI for the last 7 days
Test sandbox — replay a real event

qr.title: QR Collection
qr.subtitle: QR code on the invoice, mobile-bank payment
qr.name: QR Collection
qr.desc: Places a TR FAST / RU СБП / EU SEPA QR code on the sales invoice PDF. When the customer scans it with their mobile bank, the amount is pre-filled and paid in one tap.
features: FAST QR code (TR)
СБП QR (RU)
SEPA EPC QR (EU)
Pre-fill amount + creditor IBAN + reference
Placed on the PDF without breaking e-archive/e-invoice
Track paid/pending status live via webhook

stripe.title: Stripe Payments
stripe.subtitle: Send the customer a link, collect by card
stripe.name: Stripe Payments
stripe.desc: Email the sales invoice to the customer as a payment link. They can pay by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, IBAN — all supported methods. When the payment arrives, the receipt document is posted automatically.
features: One-click payment link
Card + Apple Pay + Google Pay + iDEAL + SEPA
Webhook → automatic receipt posting
Allow / disallow partial payment
Multi-currency (Stripe currencies)
Switch between test mode and live payments

aiOcr.title: AI OCR
aiOcr.subtitle: Automatic invoice reading from PDF & photo
aiOcr.name: AI OCR
aiOcr.desc: Reads the PDF/JPG invoice images you upload from the browser or mobile app with AI and fills in the lines. Supports Turkish + Russian + English. Accuracy ~92% (99% for e-invoice PDFs).
features: PDF + JPG + PNG + HEIC support (mobile capture)
Automatically recognizes line items (product, quantity, unit price, VAT)
Matches the customer name + tax ID to a counterparty or suggests creating a new one
Recognizes the schet-faktura format (RU)
User corrections retrain the model (tenant-scoped)
100 pages/month included in the Pro plan, $0.05/page beyond
aiOcr.notes: Images are deleted after processing. Recognized text is kept for 30 days in a tenant-specific embedding store — only to improve the accuracy of your own AI model.

egov.title: E-Government (TR)
egov.subtitle: E-invoice · e-archive · GİB integration
egov.name: E-Government (TR)
egov.desc: UBL-TR e-invoice and e-archive submission integration for the Turkish GİB. Define your fiscal seal, send the invoice in one tap, track its status live.
features: UBL-TR 1.2 e-invoice + e-archive
GİB test and live environment — switching keys is a single setting
Fiscal seal HSM/smart card support
GİB status lookup (Approved / Rejected / Pending)
XML signature verification + archiving (10-year legal retention)
PDF/Schema validation pre-check

oneC.title: 1C Migration
oneC.subtitle: Перенос данных из 1С
oneC.name: 1C Migration
oneC.importCardDesc: Import products, customers and suppliers from 1C EnterpriseData XML.
oneC.openingStockCardDesc: Import opening stock balances from a CSV or XLSX file.
oneC.desc: Imports EnterpriseData XML files exported from 1C:Бухгалтерия 8.3 into the ishflow product catalog and customer/supplier list. A three-step wizard: upload a file → preview → run.
features: Справочники: Номенклатура → Product catalog
Контрагенты → Customer or Supplier (chosen in the wizard)
Repeated import is safe — dedup via the 1C Ссылка (externalId)
Error report CSV — download failed rows in one click
Documents (Поступление/Реализация) and stock balances — Phase 2 (coming soon)
oneC.notes: On the 1C side, use the Выгрузка → Универсальный обмен данными XML option. The file is processed in memory (max 10 MB); no file is stored permanently.

bankImport.title: Bank Import
bankImport.subtitle: Payment from a bank statement · Импорт банка
bankImport.name: Bank Import
bankImport.desc: Upload the OFX, MT940, CAMT.053 or CSV statement you downloaded from your bank account. Match the rows to open receivables/payables and auto-post the payment and receipt documents.
features: OFX 2.x / MT940 / CAMT.053 / CSV
Smart matching: finds the invoice by amount + date + reference
Asks the user about ambiguous rows, posts nothing automatically
Multi-currency — the rate is pinned to its date via OXR/CBRF
Jigsaw invoice: one payment can be split across several invoices
Deduplication on re-upload (idempotent transaction hash)
